name: zclass_cls_di_raycast_select_closest_hit_between_points
description: zClass_cls_di::RaycastSelectClosestHitBetweenPoints runs the single-segment raycast helper and, when multiple candidates are returned, records the closest candidate index.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this wrapper/reduction helper; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zClass cls_di raycast source-cluster pass.
Binary Ninja HLIL keeps the nearest-candidate x87 fcom/fnstsw comparison in a low-level form, so functional evidence is tied to inspected assembly and the native raycast smoke.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x444de0 validates ECX as world, EDX as startPoint, stack arguments for endPoint and rayData, forwarding start/end coordinates to RaycastFindClosest, returning 1 for a direct helper hit, clearing candidateCount when zero or one candidate is present, scanning PlayerProbeSampleCandidateBuffer entries by the 0x28-byte stride, comparing hit positions through zMath::Vec3DeltaLengthSq, and replacing candidateCount with the closest candidate index before returning 0.

The native cls_di smoke verifies a direct raycast hit path, closest-candidate selection among multiple segment hits, empty-world no-candidate behavior, RaycastFindClosest integration, and matrix/stop-after-first-hit cleanup from the shared raycast helper.
